config.name: temporal_guard_skillcorner_v2_ballcensor
config.description: Pre-registered re-run (session 4, written before any result was seen) of temporal_guard_skillcorner_v1_02s with one change: censor_undetected_ball = true, so time-on-ball (passer_control_s, quick_release) is NaN when the count reaches a frame where SkillCorner extrapolated the ball, instead of treating the extrapolated ball as observed. Matches, rules, both 0.2 s guards, models, comparisons, seed and bootstrap are unchanged. Expectations: H-T1 (Adt -> Adt_tob) may change, in either direction (more NaN, median-imputed, may weaken it; removing fabricated short or long runs may sharpen it). C28 (Adt -> Bdt) should reproduce the v1 guard run exactly: Adt and Bdt contain no time-on-ball features and the rows are the same. H-T2 (Bdt_tob -> Bdt_tt, LR and GBM) and H-T3 (Adt_tob -> Bdt_tob) should not change materially, because time-on-ball is on both sides of those contrasts. LR models median-impute the extra NaN; the GBM handles NaN natively. Any change to H-T2 beyond bootstrap noise would be reported as a finding about how time-on-ball interacts with movement history.

Adt_logreg.description: decision-time event context only (no release features), LR

Bdt_logreg.description: decision-time event + spatial context (no release features), LR

Adt_tob_logreg.description: decision-time events + event timing + tracking time-on-ball, LR

Bdt_tob_logreg.description: decision-time spatial + event timing + time-on-ball, LR

Bdt_tt_logreg.description: decision-time spatial + timing + time-on-ball + 1.0 s movement history, LR

Bdt_tob_gbm.description: decision-time spatial + event timing + time-on-ball, GBM

Bdt_tt_gbm.description: decision-time spatial + timing + time-on-ball + 1.0 s movement history, GBM
